recognize_zh: 背景為成熟嗜中性球與單核球系細胞增多，另有核摺疊、染色質細緻的前單核球／芽細胞，其細胞質內可見細長的 Auer 小體，符合慢性骨髓單核球性白血病第二型（CMML-2）。
features: Mixture of segmented neutrophils, monocytes and immature monocytic cells (promonocytes/blasts)
Immature cells with folded or indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm
Thin, needle-like Auer rods in the cytoplasm of occasional immature cells (panel A lower cell, panel B lower center cell)
Neutrophils mostly segmented with normal to slightly reduced granulation; a granulated myelocyte-like cell in panel A
Scattered platelets and a small lymphocyte; red cells without significant poikilocytosis
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows granulocytes and monocytic cells together with scattered immature cells having delicate chromatin, folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm, consistent with promonocytes and blasts. Occasional immature cells contain slender Auer rods. Mature neutrophils show relatively preserved granulation. Findings are consistent with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia; the presence of Auer rods places the case in CMML-2 irrespective of blast count (WHO 2016).

ddx.vs: AML requires ≥20% blasts plus promonocytes in blood or marrow, whereas CMML has fewer blast equivalents with persistent monocytosis.
Reactive monocytes are mature, without increased promonocytes, dysplasia or Auer rods.
aCML shows marked dysgranulopoiesis with immature granulocytes ≥10% and monocytes <10% of leukocytes.
MDS-EB lacks the persistent absolute monocytosis (≥1 × 10^9/L and ≥10%) required for CMML.
